news.snippet: 美国司法部指控三人利用AI模仿CEO声音或形象，策划1.29亿美元诈骗案。
news.raw_snippet:
Rebecca Cohen

Rebecca Cohen is a breaking news reporter for NBC News Digital. [...] The trio and their co-conspirators would tell these employees — typically in accounting departments — they needed help with a confidential financial transaction and would use AI technology to mimic the company CEO’s voice, according to the press release. [...] Once the employee wired the money, the group would convert the cash into cryptocurrency “in an attempt to conceal the source, ownership, and control of the stolen proceeds and distribute it amongst themselves and their co-conspirators,” prosecutors said.
